_about: The values the Synthea wiki fixes for fields that are free text in the model (Generic Module Framework: Basics, Logic). One source for two readers: tools/moddle-to-xsd.mjs turns the lists in `xsd` into restrictions of the extension XSD, and the lint rules (lib/values.js) read the same lists. Fields whose valid values depend on another field (the operator per condition type, units of measurement) are checked by the lint only.
